@ a guard that holds and divides by zero panics in a call of 0 frames
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the call after calls that did not panic is the one that panics: d = 2, d = 0, then d = 1 in a call of 0 frames
process 0 params d=2 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params d=0 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ after reset the guard that holds panics in a call of 0 frames again
process 0 params d=0 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the else branch that is taken panics in a call of 0 frames
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ else if: the branch that is taken panics in a call of 0 frames, and the other ones do not
process 0 params d=0 e=1 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=2 e=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=2 e=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the right side of && panics in a call of 0 frames where the left side holds
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the right side of || panics in a call of 0 frames where the left side does not hold
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a condition of init guards a part of block: the panic is the block stage's, init does not panic
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
process 1 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a condition of block guards a part of init: init does not panic, block does where the guard holds
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ a slow condition in a slow branch: the innermost part is evaluated at block when both conditions hold
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
process 1 params d=30 frames=0 in x=[]
process 1 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ an arm reads what its pattern binds: Some(0) divides by zero in a call of 0 frames, None does not
process 0 params o=#0() frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params o=#1(4) frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params o=#1(0) frames=0 in x=[]
@ a condition with at is counted at the stage of its expression: the guard holds at block
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=1 frames=0 in x=[]
@ the second let that is guarded panics when its guard holds, the first one with its guard not holding
process 0 params d=0 e=2 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params d=0 e=1 frames=0 in x=[]
